description: Minus-zero (-0.0, IEEE 754 negative zero) MUST raise CanonError.
input_repr: Python: {'n': -0.0}  /  JavaScript: {'n': -0}  /  IEEE 754: sign=1, exponent=0, mantissa=0
input_json_note: JSON cannot represent -0 distinctly from 0. Implementations must construct this value programmatically and verify that canonical_json raises CanonError.
notes: R5: minus-zero is forbidden. math.copysign(1.0, x) == -1.0 and x == 0.0 indicates minus-zero in Python. JavaScript: Object.is(x, -0).
